name: Jinosuke
source:
A mononoke who attacked the protagonist's castle and murdered her father.
[spoiler]He was in love with the protagonist's youkai mother, Lady Yuri, but Yuri chose to marry a human and died giving birth to the protagonist. Jinosuke blamed the protagonist's father for Yuri's death.
He also wishes to marry the protagonist since she resembles her mother.[/spoiler]
